desc:
🔥 WELCOME TO PHILLY STREETZ 2 🔥
A next-gen city roleplay experience straight from the 215.

🏗️ MADE BY:
JalenBoston & On1yDJ

🎮 CONSOLE SUPPORTED

🌆 FEATURES:
• Custom Tools & Attachments
• Custom Cribs & Interiors
• Safe Storage for Your Items
• Cars You Can Flex
• Lootable Spots & Street Hustles
• Card Swipe Minigames
• Snacks & Unique Items
• Work Jobs, Build Your Name, and Run It Up
• Constant Updates with New Content

⚠️ RULES:
🚫 No Random Killing
🚫 No Glitching
🚫 No Exploiting
✅ Play Fair and Have Fun

🎮 CONTROLS:
• Left Click / R2 – Use Tool
• Shift / L2 – Sprint
• M / D-Pad Up - Emote
• T / D-Pad Up – Hangout Cars
• C / D-Pad Down – Crouch
• F / B – Chamber Tools
• T / Left Stick – Wheelie
• Phones - Tons of accessible settings
